articles.title: Saturn's New Decagon: A Giant 10-Sided Mystery
articles.summary: Saturn's south pole has a new giant 10-sided wave, like its famous hexagon but different. It's growing, and scientists don't know why it formed. Hubble is watching!

articles.title: Giant Iceberg Survives a Head-On Collision with an Island
articles.summary: An iceberg as big as St. Thomas broke off Greenland's Petermann Glacier and slammed into Joe Island—but didn't break! Scientists are amazed and watching for more breaks.

articles.title: The Duck That Came Back from the Brink—But Still Needs Help
articles.summary: White-headed ducks have blue bills and wild dances. In Spain, they dropped to just 22 birds, but now 2,500 thrive. Yet they're still endangered globally. A conservation story in progress.
